name: NY-16
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's strong Democratic lean of D+18
Incumbent George Latimer running for reelection
Republican challenger with no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price Democratic win near certain
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Latimer: an D+18 district, incumbency, and a financial edge against a Republican challenger who has shown no measurable fundraising. Markets agree, pricing a Democratic win at roughly 97%, so the forecast stays at Safe D.
model.watch: Any late surge in Republican spending or polling showing a much tighter race would warrant a downgrade, but nothing currently signals that.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
George Latimer, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking reelection in a Westchester-area district that leans Democratic by 18 points. He has raised about $514,000 and holds a cash advantage, while Republican Joseph Cinquemani reports no fundraising on file. No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and money.

Prediction markets put Latimer's chances near 97 percent, consistent with the structural advantages he carries. The seat is not considered competitive by any available signal, and the forecast treats it as safely Democratic with a wide expected margin and elevated uncertainty reflecting the absence of polling.
